chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Indeed, Allah has given you these surplus amounts of wealth so that you may direct them where Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has directed them, and He did not give them to you so that you would hoard them.

key_terms.الْفُضُولَ: surplus or excess beyond basic need
key_terms.لِتَكْنِزُوهَا: so that you hoard and store it up
key_terms.لِتُوَجِّهُوهَا: so that you direct and allocate it properly
key_terms.وَجَّهَهَا: appointed or directed it toward a specific purpose

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about surplus wealth and hoarding?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that surplus wealth is a trust from Allah and is meant to be spent in the ways He has prescribed. It condemns hoarding and directs believers toward responsible and God-pleasing financial conduct.
